column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Japheth Possession Revealed
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: W-who are you!?
You may be speaking through the $$教皇$$'s mouth...
but you are surely not her herself!!
It is true that I taught him how to build the Ark...
but I made $$ノア$$ swear never to speak of it!
And $$ノア$$ was so devout that he built a massive Ark alone, keeping it hidden even from his family...
He would not have broken his vow to me, an $$大天使$$,
and told anyone else of it...
She herself was only an infant then...
There is no possible way she knew I had taught $$ノア$$ how to build the Ark...
She could not have known!!
Oh, $$ラファエル$$!? What are you suddenly saying!?
You know me well too...
I am $$ノア$$'s daughter, $$ヤペテ$$, am I not!!
Y-your true identity is... what!?
Heh heh heh... So close. Almost had it!
Y-you! That voice is... $$強欲$$'s $$マモン$$!!
Didn't you all feel like dying of your own accord, just a little!?
T-that voice...!? $$暴食$$'s $$バアル$$!!
Did you think a fight like that could erase my resentment?!
Naturally, beautiful me is here too... and so is unremarkable $$アスタルテ$$!
...Who did you call unremarkable!?
The true identity of this $$サル$$ woman who has been deceiving us is...
apparently something Lord $$メフィスト$$ created with conception magic and an immortality curse...
to bear children who could serve as vessels...
She seems to have been just a tool, doesn't she!?
We had copied our souls into the $$大天使の鎧$$, but to reincarnate through that armor...
we still had to find a vessel somewhere with a powerful force of will...
Didn't we!?
Normally the other $$大天使$$ would have found one for us, but they all died at once...
We were secretly frantic about what to do!
But to think that five vessels were in this $$サル$$ woman's womb...
It was such a lifesaver for us!!
Now I too can be reborn...
with skin as smooth as a baby's, perhaps!?
So you were worried about it after all!
Shut up!!
This $$サル$$ woman's aim was apparently...
to reincarnate Lord $$メフィスト$$ while preventing this $$世界$$ from collapsing...
But our aim has changed now!!
Lord $$メフィスト$$ is already dead, and the current owner of his armor is too stupid to accept reincarnation...
And now, from Lord $$メフィスト$$'s remains...
we have acquired this magnificent $$教皇$$ body into which tremendous magical power flows...
Do you think anyone stronger than us exists in this $$世界$$!?
W-what have you done to the $$教皇$$—no, $$ノア$$'s daughter $$ヤペテ$$!?
That $$サル$$ woman's soul is gone already.
What!?
For all the $$教皇$$'s great magical power...
inside, she is only a $$サル$$!
By force of will, she cannot possibly match us $$大天使$$...
There is no way she can!!
She's probably somewhere playing hide-and-seek right now, isn't she!?
Y-you bastards!!
For now, our sole aim is revenge on you!
Nothing but revenge!!
There is only one body, so we will take you on one at a time, in turns!
Well then, since I have the chance!
Perhaps I shall summon the $$教皇$$'s faithful servants!!
Demon kings of the $$天魔７２将$$... obey my command and reveal yourselves!!
At once! At our $$教皇$$'s command!!
Just kidding!!
